explication: noScribe is a local desktop application for producing and reviewing interview transcripts. Users select audio and transcription options in the GUI; the app manages jobs and dispatches speech recognition and speaker diarization to worker processes, then presents transcript segments for review and export. The README also documents multilingual support and local processing for confidentiality. Worker internals and much of the GUI are only partially excerpted, so the graph shows documented or indexed relationships and omits uncertain calls.
